description: Consolidated residue matrix: gatekeeper and contact positions vs measured nucleotide specificity, with distance-to-ADP ordering
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.colors import ListedColormap

def uni(acc):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=90).text.strip().split("\n")
    return "".join(t[1:])

# positions verified twice (sequence NW + structural superposition onto 6NO0, all 42/42 agreeing)
POS = {   # acc : {site: uniprot_position}
 "B3FHP0":    dict(b20=34,  b46=60,  b111=125, b113=127, b114=128, b227=241),
 "P53590":    dict(b20=58,  b46=80,  b111=145, b113=147, b114=148, b227=257),
 "Q96I99":    dict(b20=57,  b46=79,  b111=144, b113=146, b114=147, b227=256),
 "O97580":    dict(b20=34,  b46=56,  b111=121, b113=123, b114=124, b227=233),
 "Q9P2R7":    dict(b20=72,  b46=94,  b111=159, b113=161, b114=162, b227=271),
 "P0A836":    dict(b20=20,  b46=42,  b111=100, b113=102, b114=103, b227=212),
 "A0A9P6TY68":dict(b20=34,  b46=56,  b111=121, b113=123, b114=124, b227=233),
}
LAB={"B3FHP0":("Blastocystis sp. SCS-$\\beta$","ATP"),
     "P53590":("Pig SUCLG2 (G-type)","GTP"),
     "Q96I99":("Human SUCLG2 (G-type)","GTP"),
     "O97580":("Pig SUCLA2 (A-type)","ATP"),
     "Q9P2R7":("Human SUCLA2 (A-type)","ATP"),
     "P0A836":("E. coli SucC","ATP+GTP"),
     "A0A9P6TY68":("$\\it{A.\\ ambigua}$ SUCLG2 (TARGET)","untested")}
ORDER=["P53590","Q96I99","A0A9P6TY68","O97580","Q9P2R7","P0A836","B3FHP0"]
SITES=[("b20","$\\beta$20\ncontact\n1.8 A"),("b113","$\\beta$113\ncontact\n2.5 A"),
       ("b227","$\\beta$227\ncontact\n2.9 A"),("b111","$\\beta$111\ncontact\n4.7 A"),
       ("b114","$\\beta$114\nGATE-2\n5.2 A"),("b46","$\\beta$46\nGATE-1\n7.0 A")]

seqs={a:uni(a) for a in ORDER}
grid=[]; txt=[]
cls={"D":0,"E":0,"K":2,"R":2,"H":2}
for acc in ORDER:
    row=[]; trow=[]
    for s,_ in SITES:
        aa=seqs[acc][POS[acc][s]-1]
        trow.append(f"{aa}{POS[acc][s]}")
        row.append(cls.get(aa,1))
    grid.append(row); txt.append(trow)
grid=np.array(grid)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14.5,5.0),gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[2.4,1]})
ax=axes[0]
cmap=ListedColormap(["#4878d0","#e8e8e8","#d65f5f"])  # acidic / neutral / basic
ax.imshow(grid,cmap=cmap,vmin=0,vmax=2,aspect="auto")
for i in range(len(ORDER)):
    for j in range(len(SITES)):
        ax.text(j,i,txt[i][j],ha="center",va="center",fontsize=11,
                color="white" if grid[i,j]!=1 else "black",fontweight="bold")
ax.set_xticks(range(len(SITES))); ax.set_xticklabels([s[1] for s in SITES],fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(ORDER)))
ax.set_yticklabels([f"{LAB[a][0]}\n[{LAB[a][1]}]" for a in ORDER],fontsize=9)
ax.axvline(3.5,color="k",lw=2)
ax.set_title("Nucleotide-site contact residues and gatekeeper positions across succinyl-CoA synthetase beta subunits\n"
             "(columns ordered by side-chain distance to ADP in Blastocystis structure 6NO0; blue acidic, red basic, grey neutral)",
             fontsize=10.5)
ax.text(1.5,-0.95,"inside binding site",ha="center",fontsize=9,style="italic")
ax.text(4.5,-0.95,"gatekeepers (outside cavity)",ha="center",fontsize=9,style="italic")

ax2=axes[1]
d=[1.77,2.50,2.94,4.66,5.21,6.98]
names=["$\\beta$20 Q","$\\beta$113 V","$\\beta$227 L","$\\beta$111 G","$\\beta$114 K","$\\beta$46 K"]
colors=["#777777"]*4+["#d65f5f"]*2
ax2.barh(range(6),d,color=colors)
ax2.set_yticks(range(6)); ax2.set_yticklabels(names,fontsize=10); ax2.invert_yaxis()
ax2.axvline(4.0,ls="--",color="k",lw=1)
ax2.set_xlabel("minimum side-chain to ADP distance (A)",fontsize=9)
ax2.set_title("Measured in 6NO0 chain A\n(Blastocystis SCS-$\\beta$ + Mg-ADP)",fontsize=10)
for i,v in enumerate(d): ax2.text(v+0.1,i,f"{v:.1f}",va="center",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print(pd.DataFrame(txt,index=[LAB[a][0]+" ["+LAB[a][1]+"]" for a in ORDER],
                   columns=[s[0] for s in SITES]).to_string())
print("\nTarget vs pig SUCLG2 identity at the six positions:",
      sum(txt[ORDER.index("A0A9P6TY68")][j][0]==txt[ORDER.index("P53590")][j][0] for j in range(6)),"/6")
print("Target vs Blastocystis identity at the six positions:",
      sum(txt[ORDER.index("A0A9P6TY68")][j][0]==txt[ORDER.index("B3FHP0")][j][0] for j in range(6)),"/6")
